summary: Native-share review: 0 critical. shareVideoFile seams match ADR-NS-1/2/3/5; success.file retention past download revoke; Share gated by canShareVideoFile and invoked only from click; AbortError quiet; download still additive. 32 related unit tests + typecheck green. One warning (stale shareError if share settles after dismiss/re-export). nextStage qa-acceptance.
goal: After downloading climb replay video, allow sharing via Apple & Android native share sheets (Web Share API files).

findings.issue: Share onClick awaits shareVideoFile then unconditionally setShareError / speak. If the user Dismisses or starts a new export while the OS sheet is open, a late rejection can setShareError after the next success chrome mounts (effect only clears shareError when kind !== success), showing a stale ember alert on an unrelated export. Late ok also speaks Share complete after dismiss.
findings.fix: Capture a share generation id (or the File identity) at click; after await, apply speak/setShareError only if exportStatus is still success with that same file (or generation matches). Optional: disable Share while in-flight.

findings.issue: Share has no in-flight guard; rapid double-tap can invoke navigator.share twice before the first settles.
findings.fix: Optional: sharingRef / disabled while promise pending. Not merge-blocking.

findings.issue: containerMimeForLabel + File([blob], …) assembly is private; AC-NS-7 byte/name/type retention and dismiss release remain residual (verifier). Wiring matches ADR-NS-2 and checklist §14.
findings.fix: QA device-check retention; extract buildExportFile only if unit proof is required later.

findings.issue: Contracts verified OK: files-only canShare probe; optional title on share() only; AbortError→aborted; non-abort→non-empty message; onstop builds File + downloadBlob without share; bar mounts Share only on success + canShare; ClimbScene gates bar on replaying.
findings.fix: None — proceed to QA for gesture/UI residuals (AC-NS-2/3/7/9, device Share sheet).

appliedLearnings: Confirmed non-test caller for shareVideoFile (ReplayTransportBar) before accepting coverage
Did not require revoke-timing tests for AC-NS-7 — File owns bytes independent of object URL
Accepted injectable canShare/share unit proofs; left gesture/UI ACs residual for QA
Did not treat free-leaderboard trust boundary as closed by this delta
Verified ADR-NS-1 (no share in onstop) and ADR-NS-5 (gesture in bar click) in production code

learnings.insight: Native-share reviewer: criticalCount=0; 32 related vitest + typecheck green. Share path matches ADR-NS-1/2/3/5 with success.file retention and click-only shareVideoFile.
learnings.action: Advance to qa-acceptance; device-check iOS/Android Share sheet, desktop canShare=false hide, Abort quiet, and Share complete announce.

learnings.insight: Async OS share settlement after Dismiss/re-export can apply setShareError/speak against a newer success chrome because shareError clear runs only when kind !== success.
learnings.action: After await shareVideoFile, gate UI updates on still-success + same File/generation; do not rely on kind-change effects alone for late promise results.

learnings.insight: Native-share critical bar is structural: File on success, no share in onstop, files-only canShare, Abort≠error, MIME-honest container type. Gesture/UI residuals (44px, announce, no auto-share proof) correctly stay for QA when seams are unit-proven.
learnings.action: Do not loopBack implementer solely for AC-NS-2/3/7/9 residuals when production wiring matches architecture §6 and shareVideoFile tests cover AC-NS-1/4/5/6/8.
